translations.web: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.
translations.asv: then he shall minister in the name of Jehovah his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, who stand there before Jehovah.
